mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate crossing above 6.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting recessionary expectations and reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when UNRATE crosses above 6.0%, or remain negative for less than 60% of such triggers.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators signals a robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising, or the correlation between proxies and returns is below 0.3 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate (monetary easing) strengthens equity valuations by reducing discount rates on future cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly above baseline during monetary easing periods within the late-cycle expansion regime, or the effect diminishes below 0.5 standard deviations.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to turn positive when PAYEMS rises, or the correlation between PAYEMS and returns falls below 0.2 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the INDPRO index below 95 signals contraction in production capacity, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when INDPRO falls below 95, or remain positive despite the contraction signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) creates a synergistic effect, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to rise significantly when both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS move in tandem, or the combined effect's statistical significance (p < 0.05) is absent.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals higher inflation expectations, tightening financial conditions, and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not turn negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% in the tightening regime, or the effect is inconsistent across multiple instances (p > 0.05).
